## Description

Defines the relevant market and calculates HHI/HHI-delta for a Brown Field target, including common-ownership/common-control combinations, not only direct mergers of the target entities themselves (pilot 010 finding F-2). Confirms merger-control filing requirements across every applicable jurisdiction and the gun-jumping prohibition. First of the six mandatory Brown Field DD validators (`checklists/ma-special-topics-checklist.yaml` ma-01/ma-02/ma-03), evaluated first per meeting M5's ordering rule. Use when: "antitrust screening", "HHI calculation", "merger control filing", "gun-jumping", "relevant market definition".
